"''I am. Uncle Floog retired and made me the boss.|Flix and Flanx|audio=UncleFloogRetired-FromBeneath.flac|}} '''Floog''' was a [[Gender|male]] individual who ran the [[Drahgor III station]] [[fuel]] [[refinery]] on the [[planet]] [[Drahgor III]] with the help of his nephews [[Flanx]] and [[Flix]], as well as Flix's cousins—[[Fleck]], [[Fleez]], and [[Flobb]]. At some point, Flix stopped working for Floog. By [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|6}} Therefore, Floog must have retired by 34 ABY. Floog had retired and given control of the refinery to Flanx. In that [[Standard year|year]], Flix visited the refinery to request fuel for the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. He thought his uncle would be helpful and provide him with fuel but learned of his retirement from Flanx. ==Behind the scenes== Floog was first mentioned in "[[From Beneath]]," the sixth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[November 10]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} The scene that mentioned Floog was previewed [[November 6|four]] days prior in the episode's trailer, which was posted on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.{{SWYouTube|lIDRHTM0XR8|"From Beneath" Preview | Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|From Beneath}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|lIDRHTM0XR8|"From Beneath" Preview | Star Wars Resistance}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ფლუგი }} [[Category:Drahgor III station employees]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
